weight_shift: Put your weight on your back leg and relax the front knee.
triangles: Place one hand on your hip or in a pocket to create a gap between arm and body.
angle_45: Turn your body about 45° away from the camera, then turn your face back towards it.
photographer_tips: Hold the phone at waist height, tilted slightly up, for full-body shots.

weight_shift: Let your weight roll naturally from back foot to front foot; take slow steps.
triangles: Let your arms swing slightly away from your body, or hold a bag so the elbow bends.
angle_45: Walk diagonally across the frame instead of straight at the camera.
photographer_tips: Use burst mode and pick the frame where the front foot touches the ground.
safety_note: Only walk where it’s safe; avoid roads and busy paths.

weight_shift: Keep your weight on the leg furthest from the camera as you turn.
triangles: Bend the arm nearest the camera slightly, or touch your hair, to break the straight line.
angle_45: Keep hips facing away and turn only head and shoulders, about 45° back towards the camera.
photographer_tips: Shoot from slightly behind and to the side; take several frames mid-turn.
safety_note: Stop walking before turning if the ground is uneven.

weight_shift: Rest only some of your weight on the wall or railing; keep most on your outside leg.
triangles: Bend the arm touching the wall, or cross one leg over the other.
angle_45: Angle your body about 45° to the camera rather than leaning flat against the wall.
photographer_tips: Shoot from the side the person leans away from, so the wall leads towards them.
safety_note: Never lean on railings over drops, water or roads.

weight_shift: Shift your weight onto one hip instead of sitting evenly on both.
triangles: Bend one knee up or cross your legs; rest one hand behind you so the arm makes an angle.
angle_45: Turn your body about 45° so your knees point slightly away from the camera.
photographer_tips: Lower the phone to the seated person's chest height; shooting from above shortens the body.
safety_note: Check the surface is stable and clean before sitting.
